content: ZH-CN Three Kingdoms name research workflow: authoritative sources include Baidu Baike (baike.baidu.com), Chinese Wikipedia (zh.wikipedia.org), Records of the Three Kingdoms (三国志) and Romance of the Three Kingdoms (三国演义) text. kongming.net provides Chinese/English officer name tables (both simplified 刘备 and traditional 劉備). Most Three Kingdoms figures have canonical simplified Chinese names; use simplified (简体) form for zh-cn locale. Disambiguation: hero id (e.g., han_ling_di) maps to a specific historical figure; validate against the EN name from heroes-v1.json to resolve ambiguous cases. Women and minor figures have fewer records — expect gaps, cross-check 2+ sources.
